findings.mechanism: 06-finding-n-plus-1 — N+1 query pattern: one query per item in loop causes queries_per_request scaling with result set.
findings.remediation: Replace per-item store.Reserved calls with a single batched query (e.g., join ByWarehouse with reservations) to issue only one query per request.
findings.arithmetic: queries = 1 (ByWarehouse) + N (Reserved per item). For N=100 items, queries = 101.
